# business.com

> > Expert business advice, product reviews, and resources for small business owners covering management, finance, HR, and technology.

business.com provides comprehensive guidance for entrepreneurs and small business owners, featuring expert contributors like Chad Brooks, Mark Fairlie, and Leah Zitter. The site offers practical advice on business operations, technology solutions including PBX and Wi-Fi systems, and management theories to help businesses grow.

## Key Topics

- small business advice
- business management
- accounting and finance
- human resources
- cybersecurity
- product reviews and buying guides
- expert recommendations
- business resources
- management theory
- PBX systems
- Wi-Fi solutions
- career advice
- Mary Parker Follett leadership
- ChicExecs
- content archive

## Core Resources

- [business.com: Expert Business Advice, Tips, and Resources](https://static.business.com/): Homepage offering business advice, product reviews, and buying guides
- [The Best Resources For Business Owners](https://static.business.com/content/): Business resources hub covering accounting, cybersecurity, HR, and management

## Management & Leadership

- [Mary Parker Follett Theory: Leadership & Organizational Wisdom](https://www.business.com/articles/management-theory-of-mary-parker-follett/): Article on Mary Parker Follett's management theories for small businesses
